scores.notes: Both show a round, tan block-lined pit with lions below and palms beyond its sunlit rim. The interior and elevated courtyard viewpoints are compatible.
Peter in the courtyard and stepping from the boat has the same curly graying hair, short gray beard, prominent nose and mature face.
Both show a low wooden fishing boat with a central mast on dark, breaking waves, with hilly shoreline beyond. The close interior and wider exterior views are compatible.
The planked, open fishing boat and mast match, as do the hilly shores with small buildings. The calmer water and clearing sky fit the depicted calming of the storm.
Daniel has closely cropped gray hair, a short gray beard, a narrow mature face and slim build in both the rescue and court scenes.
Both show a sandy corridor enclosed by blue water walls. The lower walls and visible desert rim on the right are compatible with a view near the shore.
The standing man before the king and the man among lions share short gray hair, a close gray beard, dark complexion and slender build.
Both boats have open wooden hulls and a single mast against terraced hills and pale shoreline buildings. Calm versus rough water is consistent with the requested storm transition.
Both shores have pale pebbles, calm water and terraced rocky hills with small stone houses and trees. The fire beside the landing is compatible across the two viewpoints.
Both depict the same kind of open wooden sailboat amid large waves, backed by a hilly shore under storm clouds. The tighter stern view exposes no conflicting landmark.
The man being lifted and the man before the throne have the same cropped gray hair, close gray beard and angular, older face.
Daniel in both panels has short gray hair, a neatly trimmed gray beard, a long angular face and a lean build.
Peter by the courtyard fire and Peter grasping the seated man's hand share curly salt-and-pepper hair, a full short graying beard and a weathered face.
Moses has the same receding swept-back white hair, long white beard, prominent nose and elderly face in the camp and rock scenes.
The kneeling youth and the youth beside the spear both have short dark curls, a smooth ruddy face and a slim adolescent build.

The crossing on the left is under a bright golden daylight sky; the parting on the right is under a dark nightlike sky with a narrow overhead glow. The descriptions do not request this time-of-day change.
The left sea is beneath a nearly black sky and isolated shaft of light, whereas the chariot corridor is in broad pale daylight. Neither description asks for a night-to-day transition.
The open planked hull, mast and hilly lakeshore are compatible in both views. The brighter sky and reduced waves on the left accompany the requested calming scene.
The camp speaker and the staff-raising man by the rock share swept-back white hair, a long white beard and an elderly profile visible on the right.
The seated central Moses and the front-left staff bearer in the crossing have matching receding white hair, full white beards and elderly, narrow faces.
Both kneeling Davids have dense short dark curls, a youthful clean-shaven face, rosy cheeks and a slender build.

Jesus is clear in the water scene, but the crucified figure's small, bowed and shadowed head does not provide enough facial detail to establish identity.
The crucified figure's face is bowed, dark and very small compared with Jesus on the water. Hair is broadly compatible, but individual facial identity cannot be judged reliably.
